correctness.rationale: Linearity of expectation gives an exact Poisson no-detection formula. The two-taxon opposite-advantage case reduces to one hyperbolic sine ratio; its second derivative has a fixed sign and the endpoint slopes give a complete unique crossing criterion, including equality boundaries. The three-taxon difference factors exactly as -y(y-1)(y^3+y^2-1)(y^6+y^4-1). The two increasing polynomials each have one distinct interior zero; y=e^{-v} gives two simple roots at (log rho)/2 and log rho with all signs fixed. The locally available standard-library checker recomputed exact factor coefficients, rational brackets and 128304 finite comparison assertions. Finite enumeration is supplementary, not the all-parameter proof.

originality.rationale: The source-supported motivation concerns comparing two eDNA capture technologies. The claimed mathematical minimum is specific to independent positive Poisson taxon capture rates with unequal total intensities. Closest published mathematical notes establish three-species one-crossing in normalized equal-size iid sampling, and in equal-census finite hypergeometric rarefaction; those are not stronger coverage of the unequal-intensity method comparison. Chase et al. discuss multiple curve crossings across broad ecological communities, but do not prove this minimum or exact three-taxon construction. Classical Poisson-species richness and elementary hyperbolic arguments are explicitly excluded from novelty. These inspections did not identify an exact covering statement; unlocated prior is a residual risk.
residual_risks: An earlier general Laplace-transform crossing theorem may immediately imply the two-rate criterion and the special witness; generalized theory is not claimed new.
Published observations of repeated rarefaction crossings make the broad phenomenon prior art, limiting novelty to the sharp restricted minimum and exact method comparison.
Rate calibration and ecological relevance of the exact integer witness are hypothetical; no real-world model fit is claimed.
The motivating article was published in December 2024, whereas middle-cohort dating relies on its explicitly dated August 27, 2024 public dataset, not journal publication.

value.rationale: Comparing sampling technologies by richness at a single volume is experimentally natural but can be structurally misleading even when the true community and method sensitivities are fixed. This result establishes the smallest number of taxa necessary for a return to the original method preference and gives a complete, easily tested two-taxon diagnostic. The explicit three-taxon construction demonstrates a genuine positive-effort reentrant regime with robust sharp boundaries. This is a motivated model-boundary fact, not an empirical recommendation, and does not rely on the already known generic observation that rarefaction curves may cross.
